Identity.title: Vision, Mission & Values
Identity.vision: To be a leading Saudi group contributing to a diversified, sustainable national economy — establishing regional and international presence through quality, innovation, and excellence.
Identity.mission: Delivering high-quality products and services in hospitality, manufacturing, and contracting — with qualified Saudi talent and advanced technology that meets the aspirations of our clients and partners.
Identity.values: Quality and excellence — continuous innovation — integrity and transparency — responsibility toward nation, community, and environment — and the relentless pursuit of improvement every single day.

CEOQuote.quote: We believe true success is measured by the impact we make on those around us — our employees, clients, and community. We started with a simple dream: to build a Saudi institution future generations will be proud of.
